visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with short black hair is wearing a mint green hooded Timberland jacket over a white t-shirt. He stands outdoors on a sidewalk with green trees and urban buildings in the background. His facial expression is cheerful as he talks directly into the camera. Suddenly, a spray of water hits him from off-camera, causing him to squint and shield his face with his right hand. (2) Close-up sequence of jacket details: a hand pulls down a zipper to reveal a dark green quilted inner lining. The camera then focuses on the wrist area, showing an adjustable black Velcro strap and a small circular logo printed on the fabric. (3) The man is indoors in a well-lit retail store with wooden floors and shoe display shelves. He is now wearing a mustard yellow jacket over black shorts. He walks forward confidently, then pulls the jacket open to demonstrate its multi-layer construction and internal pockets. (4) Scene shift to the same man wearing a navy blue jacket with a brown corduroy collar. He lifts a pocket flap to show the material texture and then demonstrates the adjustable drawstrings at the waist. (5) The man changes into a black hooded jacket, zipping it up completely. He turns to the side to show the Timberland logo on the sleeve and opens a side vent to reveal a black mesh interior. (6) Back outdoors in a sunlit alleyway, the man wears the mustard yellow jacket. A person's hand appears holding a blue bucket and throws a large volume of water directly at his face and chest. He winces and closes his eyes as the water splashes over him. (7) A close-up shows water being poured from a blue bucket onto the mint green jacket's surface. The water beads up into droplets and rolls off the fabric instantly, leaving the surface dry. (8) Split-screen comparison shows the man wearing four different jacket styles: Benton, Winnick, Barn, and Caps Ridge. He stands in the retail store, smiling and gesturing towards his outfits.

Crisp mechanical clicking and fabric rustling sounds are heard during the demonstration of the jacket's adjustment features. (3) The speaker's voice is well-enunciated and clear, with few pauses. The BGM maintains its driving tempo. (4) A massive splashing sound with broad spectral bandwidth occurs as a large volume of liquid hits a surface, accompanied by a sharp gasp and subsequent laughter from the male speaker. (5) The speaker concludes with a series of quick, energetic phrases. Short, digital 'pop' and 'ding' sound effects punctuate the transitions. The BGM fades out sharply at the end.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To promote Timberland's new line of waterproof jackets by demonstrating their stylish appearance in a retail setting and proving their high-performance water resistance through extreme outdoor splash tests.
